title: Deployment-matched CFR data smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: A solver/data pipeline using the deployed nine-slot raise grid and live preflop topologies can produce compact targets whose public-history and legal-mask support matches live v55 states, removing the dominant 98.5% action-support mismatch before policy training.
material_change: Audit and minimally extend the CFR solver-to-compact pipeline for exact v55 nine-slot action masks and both SRP and 3bet 200bb roots; run a bounded smoke and require schema, legality, history, and coverage parity.
baseline: Existing compact teacher postflop exact history+mask coverage is 1.5086%; topology coverage is 72.4138%.
source: packages/cfr-solver plus cold-stored CFR conversion scripts
command: bounded solver/converter smoke followed by teacher_live_coverage_audit.py

code.provenance_gap: Historical record predates automatic patch/source-manifest capture; the exact dirty worktree cannot be reconstructed post hoc.

notes: Implemented exact v55 [0.33,0.50,0.67,0.75,1.00,1.50] 200bb SRP/3BP configs, centralized config-specific range routing, switched 3BP IP range from approximate BTN-open filtering to actual BTN_vs_BB_facing_3bet call chart, and embedded BC/BBC preflop context in compact rows. Typecheck and 11 targeted tests pass.

First exact-grid SRP smoke hit Node's default ~4GB V8 heap limit during the initial traversal (179,972 action nodes). No completed solver artifact; reduce smoke resolution before considering a larger heap.

Bounded 2-bucket/10-iteration solves completed (SRP 625,846 + 3BP 120,087 infosets) and converted to 12,100 compact rows. Cross-engine replay exposed a deeper defect: 9,736/12,100 rows disagree on pot and 8,877 on raise count; only 69.50% legal masks match v55 despite zero target-support failures. Do not train on these rows; repair CFR HU betting-state accounting first.

After correcting HU raise accounting, fresh bounded solves/conversion produced 14,728 rows with zero replay failures, zero target failures, and exact pot/stack/to-call parity on every row. Exact deployed-mask equality is 63.00%; remaining mismatch is expected cap=1 support truncation versus v55 cap=999 and must be handled before scaled training.

Post-hoc infrastructure repair refreshed verifiable wall-time and artifact-integrity fields. The exact historical dirty-worktree patch/source manifest and placeholder commands cannot be reconstructed without falsifying provenance; the record explicitly preserves that gap.

result.summary: Built exact-grid 200bb SRP+3BP CFR roots and proved an end-to-end solver-to-v55 bridge after repairing a latent raise-accounting defect.
result.conclusion: The corrected pipeline has exact pot/stack/to-call and target-support parity on all 14,728 validation rows. A street-balanced one-board sample covers 82.33% of live postflop topology, 49.46% of public shapes with exact masks, and 39.66% of histories with exact masks, versus 72.41%, 0.11%, and 1.51% respectively for the old 96-board teacher. Remaining gaps are limped/4bet roots and cap=1 versus deployment-unlimited raises, not the prior action-grid defect.
result.next_step: Profile corrected exact-grid solver resolution/convergence under the 128GB host, then train only after selecting a tractable buckets/iterations/flop scale with heldout-board convergence evidence.
